extracted.name: Kale, Quinoa, and Avocado Salad with Lemon Dijon Vinaigrette
extracted.description: Tender steamed kale, quinoa, bell pepper, cucumber, onion, and avocado are tossed with a homemade vinaigrette in this super salad.
ingredient_lines: 1 bunch kale, torn into bite-sized pieces
instruction_lines: Bring 1 1/3 cups water and quinoa to a boil in a saucepan. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until quinoa tender and water absorbed, 15 to 20 minutes. Set aside to cool.

Place a steamer basket into a saucepan with 1 inch water; bring water to a boil. Add kale, cover, and steam until hot, about 45 seconds; transfer to a large plate. Top kale with quinoa, avocado, cucumber, bell pepper, red onion, and feta cheese.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, sea salt, and black pepper together in a bowl until emulsified; pour over salad.
